newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy offers more existing issue BTPs, CTs.
newsitem.headline: Italy offers more existing issue BTPs, CTs.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said on Tuesday it will offer the following medium to long-term paper for sale at its regular mid-month auction.
The Treasury said in a statement said it would offer:
* The fifth tranche of an issue of seven-year treasury certificates (CCTs) paying a 3.55 percent coupon.
* The ninth tranche of an issue of three-year 6 percent BTPs.
* The seventh tranche of a five-year issue of 6.25 percent BTPs.
* The 11th tranche of a 10-year issue 6.75 percent BTPs.
Bids for seven-year CCTs and 10-year BTPs have to be presented by April 15 and for three- and five-year BTPs by April 16.
